title: Vegetation change in Anta department, Salta, Argentina: Sentinel-2 NDVI, 2018 to 2025

headline.label: of NDVI gain in Anta department, Salta, 2018 to 2025

data: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance (Copernicus programme), bands B04, B08 and the scene classification layer, plus B02 and B03 for the true colour, read as windows of cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs through the Earth Search STAC API (Element 84, collection sentinel-2-l2a) on 21 November 2026: S2A_20JMT_20180428_0_L2A+S2A_20JLT_20180428_0_L2A, S2A_20JMT_20180418_1_L2A+S2A_20JLT_20180418_0_L2A, S2B_20JMT_20180523_0_L2A+S2B_20JLT_20180523_0_L2A, S2B_20JLT_20250307_0_L2A+S2B_20JMT_20250307_0_L2A, S2C_20JMT_20250511_0_L2A+S2C_20JLT_20250511_0_L2A, S2C_20JMT_20250322_0_L2A+S2C_20JLT_20250322_0_L2A.
method: Picked up to 3 of the clearest scenes in March to May of 2018 (3) and of 2025 (3) for a 23 × 22 km window, at 10 m in EPSG:32720.
Masked no-data, cloud, cirrus and cloud shadow with the scene classification layer and took the per-pixel median NDVI = (B08 − B04) / (B08 + B04) of each season.
Change = NDVI 2025 minus NDVI 2018: loss at −0.2 or less, gain at +0.2 or more, strong beyond ±0.4; patches under 9 pixels dropped; recounted at ±0.15 and ±0.25.
Noise: the same rule applied to two single scenes of the 2018 season, scaled to the analysed area.
limits: NDVI measures greenness, not land use, crop type, tree species or ownership: a harvested field, a dry season, drought or a fire scar can all read as loss, and irrigation or a wet year as gain. Two seasons are compared, not a trend. At 10 to 20 m, small plots, hedges and single trees are mixed with their surroundings.
